einzeiler: Adult acne often stems from internal root causes like gut health and stress.
kurzfassung: Holistic nutritionist Katie Stewart explains why adult acne is primarily an internal issue rather than a purely topical problem. The conversation explores the hidden impacts of birth control, gut health, nervous system regulation, and diet on skin condition. Additionally, the episode addresses common skincare misconceptions and the toxicity of everyday personal care products.
stichpunkte: Holistic nutritionist Katie Stewart specializes in addressing adult acne through functional lab testing and root-cause nutrition.
Early use of birth control can disrupt hormones, deplete key nutrients, and negatively affect the gut microbiome.
Acne is framed as an external symptom of internal imbalances involving the gut, liver, hormones, and nutrient levels.
Digestive issues such as low stomach acid and bacterial or yeast overgrowth frequently contribute to skin breakouts.
Nervous system regulation and unmanaged chronic stress play a massive role in physical healing and skin health.
Comprehensive testing, including hair trace mineral analysis and stool testing, helps tailor individual treatment protocols.
Daily habits like sleep, adequate protein intake, healthy fats, and regular bowel movements form essential health foundations.
Many commercial skincare and personal care products contain hidden toxins, endocrine disruptors, and unregulated fragrances.

beschreibung:
Episode #160 Featuring Katie Stewart

What if your acne isn’t actually a SKIN PROBLEM?

Registered Holistic Nutritionist and Functional Diagnostic Nutrition Practitioner, Katie Stewart, reveals why chronic breakouts can be a sign of deeper issues involving your gut, hormones, liver, nervous system and nutrition and why simply treating the skin may never address what’s actually causing your acne.

Katie has spent the last decade helping more than 3,000 clients across 15+ countries address chronic adult acne through root-cause nutrition and functional lab testing. She is the founder of The Clear Skin Solution and co-host of the Keep It Clear Podcast.

In this episode, she explains:

◾ Why acne can be an external symptom of an internal health problem

◾ How birth control can affect your hormones, gut health, nutrients and acne

◾ Why gut dysfunction, constipation and low stomach acid may show up through your skin

◾ How chronic stress and a dysregulated nervous system can make acne harder to resolve

◾ The truth about Accutane, antibiotics and conventional acne treatments

◾ How protein, healthy fats, carbohydrates, caffeine and alcohol can affect your skin

◾ Which skincare products are actually worth spending money on

◾ Why fragrances and certain ingredients in personal care products may interfere with your

hormones
